decisions.reason: The IMU module is a low-cost, in-house produced building block of the modular system and keeps serving steady developer and education demand, though the move to newer connectors could eventually prompt a successor version.
The industrial AC voltage input module has its own page and fits the firm's push into industrial automation and energy management, so it remains strategically relevant.
A four-channel solid state relay is a standard control component that complements the platform and costs little to keep in the catalogue.
The RGB LED control module was launched only recently, extends the building block system and is cheap to maintain, so withdrawing it now makes little sense.
Remote access for wallboxes supports the strategic expansion of the charging and energy management business and adds recurring service value to installed chargers.
